ownership_reason: Only the gold pairs the String with each of the words 'true', 'on' and 'yes'; hop 1 sees the length alone (and rightly passes on a three-character String such as 'tru', which has the length of 'yes') and hops 2-4 pass the String along, so no hop knows the words, and after the gold the answer is a boolean. A word matches only as a whole String, compared from its first character: the facade's javadoc says 'true', 'on' or 'yes' (case insensitive) give true and anything else false; the String overload toBooleanObject(String) compares the String with each word separately using String.equalsIgnoreCase (test_toBooleanObject_String: 'oof' and "" -> null); StrBuilder.equalsIgnoreCase compares the whole content case-insensitively and returns false when the sizes differ (testEqualsIgnoreCase); StrBuilder.indexOf(String, int) restarts its character cursor at 0 for every candidate position (testIndexOf_String_int).
